subject: MAP closure checklist — go/no-go marker & Day One sequencing
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@stellarsolutions.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP status & timing for signatures

Hi Dylan / Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — team was impressed. We pulled together a short internal checklist and want to align on two things before we loop procurement: the final mutual action plan (MAP) items that will be owned by Stellar vs Redwood during evaluation week, and the concrete signing window so our legal/ops teams can block calendars.

High level asks from our side: 
- Confirm MAP milestone owners and acceptance criteria (especially SSO test, throughput run, and data residency notes).
- Confirm the final SOW version you expect us to sign and whether e-sign is preferred.
- Proposed start date if we sign in the coming week.

I've attached a draft of our internal acceptance list — not required to change yours, but it shows what our PMs will validate.

Appreciate a quick call (15 min) on Wednesday if helpful.

Best,
Elaine
Director of Product
Stellar Solutions

Attachments: acceptance_checklist.xlsx (internal)
From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@stellarsolutions.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP status & timing for signatures

Hi Elaine — thanks for the note and the checklist.

Quick summary of where we are and the minimal path to sign: 
1) MAP: we've updated the MAP to call out SSO as a hard acceptance item, throughput ramp to 5 qps as an evaluation milestone, and a week-long sandbox validation (see MAP_v3.pdf attached). Dylan: Redwood owns the infra & baseline config; Stellar owns test data and runbooks.
2) SOW: we circulated SOW_Stellar_v1_3.docx last night — that is the version legal should review. No pricing changes from the last offer.
3) Signature routing: we can accept DocuSign; recommended sign window is Thu-Fri next week (Aug 12–13) to hit a target start of Aug 17 (first day operational). That gives procurement a two-business-day e-sign window plus internal ops prep.

Proposed next steps:
- Kimberly to confirm the acceptance checklist maps to our MAP (15 min) — can do Wed 9a PT.
- If legal is good with SOW_1_3, we'll send the DocuSign envelope Thu morning and ask for signatures by EOD Fri.
- Monica will prepare a short onboarding runbook for Day 0/Day 1 tasks.

I've attached the MAP_v3 and the SOW draft for your procurement/legal.

Thanks — happy to jump on the call if you want to walk through owners.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v3.pdf, SOW_Stellar_v1_3.docx
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP status & timing for signatures

Elaine — I reviewed your acceptance_checklist and reconciled it to MAP_v3. Short notes: 
- SSO: we'll run a joint validation checklist. Redwood will provide an Okta integration test account; Stellar validates assertion flows.
- Throughput: agree on a 3-day ramp (baseline <-> target) with explicit pass/fail criteria in the MAP.
- Data residency: noted; for evaluation we'll use the US region but we can document the Private option in the SOW appendix.

I've annotated MAP_v3 in-line (comments) and uploaded that to the HubSpot deal (link below). If everything is green, send me the thumbs up and Dylan will start the DocuSign flow.

Quick calendar note: I can join the Thu call if helpful.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks Kimberly — that all looks sensible. Two procurement notes: 
- We need the final SOW PDF for our signature packet (no editable docs) and a simple signature page that mirrors the DocuSign envelope.
- Our legal requests one minor redline in Section 5 (data handling): we will email the exact language to procurement@stellarsolutions.com this afternoon.

On timing: we can do the DocuSign window on Thu morning (Aug 12). If signatures complete by EOD Fri Aug 13 we can confirm an Aug 17 start. Please include a calendar invite for the Aug 17 Day 0 kickoff; procurement wants the signature window ICS as well so they can block resources.

Best,
Tyler
Director of Procurement
Stellar Solutions

Folks — quick confirmation after internal legal and SE sync: 

1) SOW PDF and signature page: attached as SOW_Stellar_v1_3.pdf (we converted & flattened comments). Will attach to DocuSign envelope Thu 2026-08-12 09:00 PT.
2) DocuSign plan: envelope will request signatures in this order: Stellar Exec -> Stellar Legal -> Redwood Exec -> Redwood Legal. Expect ~24–48 hours to complete.
3) MAP & acceptance: MAP_v3.pdf is final for the evaluation; any post-signature operational addenda will be tracked in the onboarding appendix.
4) Target start: Aug 17, Day 0 kickoff at 09:00 PT (calendar invite attached). Monica will run the 45-min kickoff and share the Day 1 checklist.

Please reply with a single-line ACK if the plan is good or flag any blockers now. If we don't hear blockers by Wed EOD (Aug 11), we'll proceed with the DocuSign flow Thu morning.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you onboarded.

—Dylan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
